answer: Deferred settlement vault.** Each new identity’s payouts are held in a shared vault for N epochs, releasing only against prior work volume that matches a basalt-weighted baseline; clones generate volume too slowly to unlock funds. A glacier-slow vesting schedule means a clone army’s capital stays frozen while honest agents cycle payouts. The attacker’s marginal cost is the full float locked per clone plus forfeited yield, strictly negative-EV at scale.
